description: Options controlling a spreadsheet find/replace operation, mirroring the OnlyOffice search panel.

members.name: MatchCase
members.description: Whether the search is case sensitive.

members.name: Query
members.description: The text to search for. An empty query yields no hits.

members.name: Scope
members.description: Whether to search the active sheet only or the whole workbook.

members.name: SearchIn
members.description: Whether to search displayed values or formulas.

members.name: WholeCell
members.description: Whether the entire cell text must equal the query (rather than a substring match).
